confidence_notes: Food and drink anchors use aggregated cost-of-living figures (MyLifeElsewhere, Whereandwhen, Citycost) and some older bar guides, so they are ballpark values. Beer, coffee and inexpensive meal are the more reliable anchors. Cocktail and wine are less certain and rely on older guides, and the wine figure is weakly sourced. Tourist-centre prices may run above the averages. Accommodation anchors are holistic model estimates from general knowledge and city context, not checked against live listings, so they are low confidence. No accommodation prices were searched.
comparable_city_reasoning: Southeast Asian mid-sized tourist cities with similar price levels, such as Phnom Penh and Luang Prabang, plus the Siem Reap aggregated cost-of-living figures for food and drink. Accommodation is a holistic estimate for a tourism-driven Cambodian city.
